# Mindorion

> Mindorion is the enterprise operating system for Engineering & IT Services firms — unifying proposals, commercial execution and governance so teams align execution with strategy and decide on reality, not scattered reporting.

Mindorion provides two applications on one platform: ProposalIQ (pre-sales and proposal operations) and GrowthIQ (commercial execution intelligence). A cross-platform Governance Layer keeps every workflow producing structured, auditable operational data — it is a layer across the platform, not a standalone product.

- [GrowthIQ](/products/growthiq): Commercial execution intelligence — align commercial activity with strategy and turn it into decision intelligence.
